summary.text: Tyson Miyake is a Democratic member of the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 10, appointed in December 2023 and seeking election to a new term on November 3, 2026. Before joining the legislature he ran a business and served in Maui County government.

paragraphs.text: Tyson Miyake earned a bachelor's degree in business management from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in 2005.
From 2005 to 2019 he ran a concrete accessories business, and in 2019 he became Deputy Managing Director of the County of Maui, then served as the county's Chief of Staff from 2020 to 2023.
Gov. Joshua Green appointed Miyake to District 10 on December 15, 2023, to replace Troy Hashimoto, and he took office on January 1, 2024.
For 2025-2026 he serves on the Finance Committee and is vice chair of the Housing and Transportation committees.
He defeated Ki'i Kaho'Ohanohano in the August 8, 2026 Democratic primary, 77.5 percent to 22.5 percent, and faces Republican Travis Bumanglag in the general election.
